data: ESPN public scoreboard, month by month from 2014 (model_loop/adapters/ufc/ingest.py); a bout is scored when it ended with a winner; draws update ratings at 0.5 and are not scored
selection: lowest tune-window log loss over every decided bout

serve_rule.validation: n >= 1000 and log loss below the coin flip with the paired 95% interval below zero
serve_rule.holdout: 2025 log loss below the coin flip (read once)

weekly_rule: full 2016-to-date log loss falls by >= 0.0005 with its paired 95% interval below zero, Brier no worse, and the most recent full season no worse on either
symmetry: no feature depends on which fighter the feed lists first
disclosure: Before this file was written, only the data pack's 2024 bouts were in the repository; the Elo was run on them (engine/lab/ufc_elo.json; and once here to check the code). Nothing from 2014-2023 or 2025-2026 had been read.
